ننتهب (form VIII)
# نَنْتَهِبُ (nantahibu) /nan.ta.hi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# نُنْتَهَبُ (nuntahabu) /nun.ta.ha.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# نَنْتَهِبَ (nantahiba) /nan.ta.hi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# نُنْتَهَبَ (nuntahaba) /nun.ta.ha.ba/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
